name: kilim-contracts
description: Kilim motifs, the 1/1 and the native ETH auction contracts

scripts.build: node scripts/verify-upstream.mjs && node scripts/forge.mjs build --sizes --skip test --skip script
scripts.test: node scripts/verify-upstream.mjs && node scripts/forge.mjs test -vv && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "../site/test/*.test.mjs" && pnpm -s test:pack && pnpm -s test:page
scripts.test:ci: node scripts/verify-upstream.mjs && FOUNDRY_PROFILE=ci node scripts/forge.mjs test -vv && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "../site/test/*.test.mjs" && pnpm -s test:pack && pnpm -s test:page
scripts.deploy:dry: node scripts/stores.mjs --check && KILIM_DEPLOY_CONFIG=deploy/local.json node scripts/forge.mjs script script/DeployKilim.s.sol --sig 'run()'
